system.unidentifiedDesc: An odd ring that seems to fit any finger perfectly.
system.description: This valuable ring will negate the effects of [[/r 1d6 #Charges]] energy drain attacks. If the wearer is struck by an energy-draining undead (or effect), charges are drained from the ring and no levels are lost. If a single blow drains more experience levels than there are charges remaining in the ring, the ring disintegrates; otherwise, it becomes a ring of protection +1 when all the charges are used.
